per_k256_slab: cooperative arithmetic Q6 decode into LDS

analysis.simple_double_buffering: insufficient alone: Q6 decode is arithmetic executed by the same waves, not an asynchronous global-to-LDS copy
analysis.required_overlap: dedicated producer wave(s) decoding the next slab into a second 16 KiB LDS buffer while consumer waves execute WMMA on the current slab
analysis.risk: producer/consumer role split changes wave allocation and requires per-buffer handoff synchronization; shared4r9 is already VGPR256, so first screen shared4r6 rather than shared4r9

decision: Y3 remains open. The first algorithmic candidate is a shared4r6 producer/consumer double-buffered kernel, screened on actual wide-planar rows288/536/1024 under the existing exact parent contract.
